AgentRuntimeExecutionRecord.description:
A single structured record of one agent tool execution.

Optional fields are still serialized as `null` so external consumers can rely on a stable schema across shell and non-shell tools.

agent_id.description: The agent that executed the tool.

agent_role.description: Human-readable role label for the agent (e.g. "build-agent"). Falls back to `agent_type` from the spawn event if no explicit role.

command.description: The command string for shell-family tools; `None` for all others.

cwd.description: Resolved working directory (absolute path) at execution time.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the tool execution in milliseconds.

exit_code.description: Process exit code for shell-family tools; `None` for non-process tools.

fallback_used.description: Whether a model/fallback occurred during the agent turn. `false` by default; `true` only when a different model or provider was actually used.

had_error.description: Whether the tool execution ended with an error condition. For shell tools this corresponds to a non-zero exit code. For non-shell tools this is `true` when the tool produced an error result.

model.description: The model identifier used for the agent turn that produced this tool call.

parent_agent_id.description: Parent agent of the executing agent, if any.

permission_decision.description:
Final permission decision for this tool invocation.

`None` when the decision could not be determined.

retry_count.description: Number of model-level retries that occurred before this execution completed. `0` means no retries; does **not** include command-internal retries.

schema_version.description:
Schema version for forward-compatibility.

Current version: `1`.

session_id.description: Opaque session identifier shared across all events in a session.

stderr_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the raw stderr content.

stdout_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the raw stdout content.

tool_use_id.description: The tool-use correlation id used to match `ToolUse` / `ToolResult` pairs.

AgentRuntimePermissionDecision.description:
Final permission decision for a runtime tool invocation.

Serde uses lower_snake_case so the wire format stays the existing string contract while Rust call sites use typed variants.
